description: Real-image evaluation set for the FitOS Roboflow SAM3 workflow. Add gym photos and manually verified labels before drawing accuracy conclusions.

cases.notes: One clearly visible lat pulldown machine.
Chest press, cable machine, treadmill, and dumbbell rack in one wide gym photo.
Multiple benches, dumbbells of different sizes, and several cable stations. Label individual objects separately.
Machines partially hidden behind other machines.
People stand between machines and partially block equipment.
People use a chest press, lat pulldown, and treadmill. Label equipment; do not treat people as equipment or occupancy proof.
Front, side, diagonal, and elevated camera angles. Label each frame independently.
Dim gym, harsh reflections, and backlighting. Label each frame independently.
Small machines across a large gym.
A machine occupies most of the image.
Equipment variant not explicitly represented by current prompt mappings; unknown labels should not be guessed into a canonical type.
Empty room, people only, and unrelated objects. Use an empty ground-truth list for each verified no-equipment image.
Pull-up bars and mats/open floor without conventional machines. Label only actual supported equipment such as a visible pull-up bar.
Two overlapping frames containing the same machine. Manually verify that repeated detections refer to one tracked object while separate nearby machines remain distinct.
Blurry, compressed, and low-resolution images. Label each frame independently.

liveScanCases.steps: Keep camera stationary while a person walks past one machine.
liveScanCases.equipmentRecognition: Compare equipment labels before/during/after; they should remain stable.
liveScanCases.occupancy: Not measured by the current equipment detector; do not infer occupancy from a person detection.

liveScanCases.equipmentRecognition: Check that each visible canonical type appears and remains after the UI evidence threshold.

liveScanCases.steps: Keep one machine visible across consecutive frames.
liveScanCases.equipmentRecognition: Confirm repeated frames do not create duplicate equipment types in the completed inventory.

liveScanCases.steps: Partially obstruct a machine, then reveal it.
liveScanCases.equipmentRecognition: Check the label recovers without adding an unrelated type.

liveScanCases.steps: Have a person approach, use, and leave a machine.
liveScanCases.equipmentRecognition: Check equipment recognition separately from the person's presence.
liveScanCases.occupancy: No occupancy model/label is exposed by the current API; record as not implemented, not a pass/fail inference.
